reason_for_nail_row_second_layer: Route the four feeds behind the narrow nail electrodes instead of consuming the leading contact width with a side bus.

materials.copper_type: Rolled annealed; verify supplied foil and minimum thickness
materials.tpu_cover_basis: Retain the R1 silicone-cover recipe as the initial comparison
notes: The 31.5 um minimum copper is a procurement/measurement requirement, not a published guaranteed JLCPCB tolerance.
One-layer covered regions are nominally 0.11 mm; two-layer regions with both coverlays are nominally 0.20 mm.
Active conductor faces need large coverlay openings; bare active sections have different thickness from covered tails.
The complete perimeter seal and layer offsets still require an assembly-stack design.
Use the published trace-width tolerance when computing path resistance; nominal width alone is insufficient.
No vias are planned in the dynamically bending TPU patches or free tail bends.
The narrow connector fan-out and short electrode feeds must be included in the path integral.
Keep unintended feed traces insulated from the conductive film.
Use separate row and column tails for each of six patches.
Select stiffeners from the actual exposed-finger stack and verify finished thickness against the connector drawing.
Read the complete specification and recommended land pattern before selecting this connector for release.
